data.body: Starting /rebar-implement on epic pink-complex-xenurine (c4c8-317a-85ca-4b08): "Retire the kernel severity label in favor of numeric priority (blocking/not-blocking)". Decomposed via /rebar-brainstorm into 6 linear-stack tasks: 1) pudgy-jolly-guppy (ADR, plan-review CERTIFIED already), 2) uncheering-uncivil-pig (DET-tier priority backfill), 3) beaming-snively-urial (rank aggregation by priority), 4) patriotic-abdicative-arrowana (surface blocking/advisory in review-bot/CLI), 5) camlet-exodermal-kodiakbear (migrate fail_on_severity to priority threshold), 6) byzantine-spinelike-penguin (drop severity field, BREAKING). depends_on chain 2->1->...->6. Landing method: rebar/Gerrit default (stacked refs/for/main changes, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1 gate, submit top of stack). Worktree: /Users/joeoakhart/implement-retire-severity-1486 on branch implement-retire-severity-1486, based on origin/main @ 1b5ecd2d8e3d.
